info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Bromide Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Bromide Laptop Detail Creation API enables businesses to add detailed specifications and features of Bromide laptops to their product catalog. This endpoint supports the seamless integration of new laptop data, ensuring that product offerings remain up-to-date and informative. Targeted at developers and e-commerce platforms, this API facilitates efficient inventory management and enhances customer experience through rich product listings. Utilize this API to streamline the onboarding process for new laptop entries into your catalog.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create details for a Bromide laptop. It expects the necessary details in the request body, and upon successful creation, it will return the created details along with a confirmation.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating the details of a Bromide Laptop. It should contain the necessary information pertaining to the laptop specifications, features, and any other relevant attributes to accurately represent the laptop's details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the laptop details.
